## YouTube Music

- **Stream download playlist sync:** Keep saved playlists up to date on unmetered Wi-Fi while Music is open.
  Existing local copies are reused; the refreshed offline list is published only when its new songs are ready.
  If a refresh cannot finish, the last playable offline list stays available. No new setting is needed.
  Available on Music **8.30.54, 9.15.51, 9.40.51 and experimental 9.45.51**; older versions keep their existing
  download behavior.
